playback_controls.note: Initial helper used JavaScript array index -1 and always returned false; after fixing the helper, .vplay click activated the playing class on both devices. This was a test-harness bug, not an app bug.

limitations: No real microphone sample was captured on either device; audio-source errors are environmental (no input device exposed).
